name: COMP_059
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (41%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
InSitu (41%) barely leads Invasive (39%) in the 90% conformal set [F1], with positive simulated margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 41%, Invasive 39%, Benign 19%, Normal 1% | Nearly tied top classes |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%, 90% test coverage) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%), 2/5 Invasive [F5] | Split with Invasive neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+1.08 SD); strongest invasive driver [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical (-0.71 SD); descriptive only (8/20 check) [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+1.48 SD); pushes toward invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical confinement (-0.66 SD) pushes toward invasive · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (+0.40 SD), but 0/20 check is unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (4, 6, 8, 9, 11) harbor true invasion, matching invasive contrast case BACH_0278 (87% similarity).
- Composite frozen-section simulation distorts morphology or margins (reliability AUROC 70%; stains blocked).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 6, 8, 9, 11**: Highest risk (96%–100%); assess stromal invasion and pleomorphism.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11**: Check positive inferior (538 um), lateral (323 um), medial (215 um) margins.
3. **Regions 2, 3**: Low risk (0%–2%) where duct confinement and TILs peak; verify intact ducts.
